candidates.title: Modified Candlestick / Dragon Flag
candidates.description: This is a modified version of a candlestick aka “Dragon Flag” that requires a bench to perform. We are only performing the eccentric (lowering) portion of this and utilizing a knee tuck to return back to the top position. These will help to build a full candlestick over time and are more possible for most people.
